cim: Hawaiʻi Legislature to hold informational briefing on artificial intelligence innovation
cim_eredeti: Hawaiʻi Legislature to hold informational briefing on artificial intelligence innovation
szoveg_eredeti:
The Senate Committee on Labor and Technology, chaired by Senator Brandon J.C. Elefante, and House Committee on Economic Development & Technology, chaired by Representative Greggor Ilagan, will convene a joint informational briefing to examine the development and application of artificial intelligence (AI), its role in government operations, and emerging opportunities for workforce development.

The briefing will take place on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. at Conference Room 329 at the Hawaiʻi State Capitol. It will also be available via videoconference.

The informational briefing will provide legislators with an opportunity to gain a greater understanding of the evolving landscape of artificial intelligence and its implications for state government, cybersecurity, and workforce development.

Following each 15-minute presentation, committee members will have the opportunity to ask questions of the presenters.

As is customary for informational briefings, no public testimony will be accepted.

Members of the public are encouraged to attend. The hearing notice, agenda, and additional meeting information, including the link to the livestream, are available HERE.
